senses.gloss: to sleep; to die, to lie in the grave.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 3:6">Targ. Ps. III, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 4:9">Ib. IV, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 72:3">Gen. R. s. 72</cite>, beg. <he>עמך הוא דמיך</he> he (Jacob) will lie with thee in the grave.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:9">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, a. fr. <he>כד ד׳ וכ׳</he> when R. … was dead; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">Ruth R. to III, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>ודַמְכַת לה</he> and the fire over the grave died out.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 5:11">Targ. Koh. V, 11</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:13">Targ. Job III, 13</cite>, some ed.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᶜ top <he>וההוא גברא יתיב מְדַמַּךְ</he> (not <he>מדרך</he>) and this man (I, thou) dreamt that he was sitting and sleeping.

senses.gloss: to feel the approach of death. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ
